Act11-1#1.zh: 杨志，这些是『生辰纲』全部的货物吗？
Act11-1#1.t: Yang Zhi, is this all the goods from the 'birthday gifts'?

Act11-1#2.zh: 只是其中的一小部份...其他不知道在哪里。
Act11-1#2.t: Only a small part of it... I don't know where the rest is.

Act11-1#3.zh: 壮士！这些大部分是我辛辛苦苦卖命赚来的血汗钱啊...壮士如果还有江湖道义的话，这些金银珠宝请尽量拿，只要放小人一条生路就可以了...
Act11-1#3.t: Hero! Most of this is blood and sweat money I risked my life for... If you've any sense of the code of the rivers and lakes, take as much gold and jewels as you like, just spare my life...

Act11-1#4.zh: 说！你把『生辰纲』藏在哪里？！
Act11-1#4.t: Talk! Where have you hidden the 'birthday gifts'?!

Act11-1#5.zh: 冤枉啊...小人真的不知道什么生辰纲、生死纲的玩意；那位『白日鼠』白胜最近发了一笔横财，你们有事就找他好了！
Act11-1#5.t: I'm innocent... I really know nothing about birthday gifts or deathday gifts. That 'Daylight Rat' Bai Sheng came into a windfall lately; ask him!

Act11-1#6.zh: 邓爷！你怎么这么轻易就把我卖了？！
Act11-1#6.t: Master Deng! How could you sell me out so easily?!

Act11-1#7.zh: 生命要紧啊！各位英雄好汉，你就把我给放了吧！
Act11-1#7.t: Life comes first! Heroes, good fellows, please just let me go!

Act11-1#8.zh: 你是『白日鼠』白胜？！说！其他的财宝呢？！跟你同伙的那些人呢？！
Act11-1#8.t: You're 'Daylight Rat' Bai Sheng?! Talk! Where's the rest of the treasure?! Where are your accomplices?!

Act11-1#9.zh: 哼！我白胜也有江湖道义的！我不会轻易地出卖同伴，你就算把我打死我也不会...
Act11-1#9.t: Hmph! I, Bai Sheng, have my code too! I won't sell out my comrades so easily. Even if you beat me to death I won't...

Act11-1#10.zh: 哇～大爷，你拿出刀子干什么...很危险的....
Act11-1#10.t: Waah~ Sir, what are you taking out a knife for... that's dangerous....

Act11-1#11.zh: 如果追不回『生辰纲』，我重回朝廷的一丝希望就完了！说！『生辰纲』在哪里！
Act11-1#11.t: If I can't recover the 'birthday gifts', my last hope of returning to the court is gone! Talk! Where are the 'birthday gifts'!

Act11-1#12.zh: 不要杀我！不要杀我！我说，我说！先把刀子放下...
Act11-1#12.t: Don't kill me! Don't kill me! I'll talk, I'll talk! Put the knife down first...

Act11-1#13.zh: 其实夺取『生辰纲』不是我的主意。附近东溪村有个保正，人称『托塔天王』晁盖，他是主谋；家中有个先生，人称『智多星』吴用，他是策划整个行动的人。其他还有『赤发鬼』刘唐、『入云龙』公孙胜、『立地太岁』阮小二、『短命二郎』阮小五、『活阎罗』阮小七，总共就是这些人了。
Act11-1#13.t: Actually, taking the 'birthday gifts' wasn't my idea. There's a headman in nearby East Creek Village called 'Pagoda King' Chao Gai; he's the ringleader. A teacher in his house, 'Wizard' Wu Yong, planned the whole thing. Then there's 'Red-haired Demon' Liu Tang, 'Dragon in the Clouds' Gongsun Sheng, 'Earthly Demon' Ruan Xiao'er, 'Short-lived Second Son' Ruan Xiaowu and 'Living King of Hell' Ruan Xiaoqi. That's all of them.

Act11-1#15.zh: 我分了我应得的那份，就离开了东溪村；他们应该还在晁盖家中。
Act11-1#15.t: I took my share and left East Creek Village. They should still be at Chao Gai's house.

Act11-1#16.zh: 不好了，官兵看到山上起火，有许多官兵都包围上来了。
Act11-1#16.t: Trouble! Government troops saw the fire on the mountain, and lots of them are closing in.

Act11-1#17.zh: (糟糕，现在我们有不少人被通缉，最好还是避避风头...)
Act11-1#17.t: (Bad. Quite a few of us are wanted men. Better to lie low...)

Act11-1#18.zh: %X兄，有什么难言之隐吗？...就交给我好了。
Act11-1#18.t: Brother %X, something you'd rather not say? ...Leave it to me.

Act11-1#19.zh: 二龙山，杨志问出『生辰纲』的线索。
Act11-1#19.t: Twin Dragon Mountain: Yang Zhi gets a lead on the 'birthday gifts'.
